description: Fix four defects in app/Services/PaymentService.php that together prevent all cross-currency settlement tests from passing. (1) resolveAccountId() and resolveForexAccountId() call FinancialAccount::query()->find() which applies the TenantScoped global scope, returning null when no company context is active. Fix: use FinancialAccount::withoutGlobalScope(CompanyScope::class)->find() and rely on the existing company_id check. (2) recordSupplierPayment(), recordPartnerPaidPurchase(), and recordCustomerReceipt() call resolveExchangeRate() unconditionally in their default payload, throwing 'No exchange rate available' even when the caller already passed exchange_rate. Fix: make the call conditional on exchange_rate being absent from $attributes. (3) preparePaymentAttributes() also calls resolveExchangeRate() unconditionally for its exchange_rate default. Fix: same conditional pattern. (4) preparePaymentAttributes() defaults applied_exchange_rate to the payment's own exchange_rate (= 1 for SYP payments) instead of the purchase's original rate R₀. Fix: when payableNativeCurrency != paymentCurrency and applied_exchange_rate is not supplied, use the payable record's stored exchange_rate as applied_exchange_rate. No changes to AccountingService, no new migrations, no new files.
steps: Step 1 — Fix resolveAccountId(): In the explicit-ID branch, change FinancialAccount::query()->find($accountId) to FinancialAccount::withoutGlobalScope(\App\Eloquent\CompanyScope::class)->find($accountId). In the fallback-query branch (no ID supplied), change FinancialAccount::query()->where(...) to FinancialAccount::withoutGlobalScope(\App\Eloquent\CompanyScope::class)->where(...). The company_id check that follows already enforces tenant isolation. File: app/Services/PaymentService.php, method resolveAccountId().

Step 2 — Fix resolveForexAccountId(): Same change — FinancialAccount::query()->find($accountId) → FinancialAccount::withoutGlobalScope(\App\Eloquent\CompanyScope::class)->find($accountId). File: app/Services/PaymentService.php, method resolveForexAccountId().

Step 3 — Fix recordSupplierPayment() default exchange_rate: Replace the unconditional 'exchange_rate' => $this->resolveExchangeRate(...) in the $payload array with a conditional: isset($attributes['exchange_rate']) ? $attributes['exchange_rate'] : $this->resolveExchangeRate($purchase->currency ?? $company->base_currency, $purchase->base_currency ?? $company->base_currency, $company). File: app/Services/PaymentService.php, method recordSupplierPayment(), the $payload array.

Step 4 — Fix recordCustomerReceipt() default exchange_rate: Same pattern as Step 3, using $revenue->currency and $revenue->base_currency. File: app/Services/PaymentService.php, method recordCustomerReceipt().

Step 5 — Fix recordPartnerPaidPurchase() default exchange_rate: Same pattern as Step 3, using $purchase->currency and $purchase->base_currency. File: app/Services/PaymentService.php, method recordPartnerPaidPurchase().

Step 6 — Fix preparePaymentAttributes() conditional resolveExchangeRate: The line '$exchangeRate = $this->normalizeAmount((string) ($attributes['exchange_rate'] ?? $this->resolveExchangeRate($currency, $baseCurrency, $company)), ...)' calls resolveExchangeRate unconditionally. Change to: use isset($attributes['exchange_rate']) ? $attributes['exchange_rate'] : ($currency !== $baseCurrency ? $this->resolveExchangeRate($currency, $baseCurrency, $company) : '1'). File: app/Services/PaymentService.php, method preparePaymentAttributes().

Step 7 — Fix preparePaymentAttributes() applied_exchange_rate default: After the block that resolves $payableNativeCurrency from the payable record, also capture $payableOriginalRate = null. If $payableRecord is not null and $payableRecord->exchange_rate is set and > 0, store it as $payableOriginalRate. Then when deriving $appliedExchangeRate, use: $attributes['applied_exchange_rate'] ?? ($payableOriginalRate !== null && $payableNativeCurrency !== null && $payableNativeCurrency !== $currency ? $payableOriginalRate : $exchangeRate). This ensures that for a SYP payment toward a USD purchase (R₀=12000), applied_exchange_rate = 12000 instead of 1. File: app/Services/PaymentService.php, method preparePaymentAttributes().
Step 8 — Run Pint to fix code style: vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent. File: app/Services/PaymentService.php.
acceptance_criteria: resolveAccountId() and resolveForexAccountId() successfully find FinancialAccount records without an active company context (no runForCompany wrapper needed)
recordSupplierPayment() does NOT call resolveExchangeRate when exchange_rate is present in $attributes
preparePaymentAttributes() stores applied_exchange_rate = R₀ (purchase's exchange_rate) for cross-currency payments when applied_exchange_rate is not explicitly supplied
preparePaymentAttributes() stores applied_currency = purchase's currency (e.g. USD) when payableNativeCurrency differs from payment currency
postPaymentJournal() produces 3-line journal for exchange loss (base_debit = base_credit) without any changes to AccountingService
All previously passing tests (148 + the 1 rollback test) continue to pass
verification: php vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/PartnerPaidPurchaseTest.php --no-coverage  (all 14 must pass — these were passing before and test the account resolution path)
php vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/CrossCurrencySettlementTest.php --no-coverage  (should see the test-data failures now instead of 'No exchange rate' errors — progress verification)
php vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/PaymentAccountingTest.php --no-coverage  (regression — must still pass)
php vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/PaymentOutstandingTest.php --no-coverage  (regression — must still pass)
findings: All four fixes applied successfully. (1) resolveAccountId() now uses withoutGlobalScope(CompanyScope::class) on both the explicit-ID lookup and the fallback whereIn query; tenant isolation is preserved by the explicit company_id check that follows. (2) resolveForexAccountId() now uses withoutGlobalScope(CompanyScope::class)->find(). (3) resolveExchangeRate calls in recordSupplierPayment(), recordCustomerReceipt(), and recordPartnerPaidPurchase() are now conditional on exchange_rate being absent from $attributes. (4) preparePaymentAttributes() now (a) only calls resolveExchangeRate for exchange_rate when $currency !== $baseCurrency, defaulting to '1' for same-currency; and (b) captures the payable record's stored exchange_rate as $payableOriginalRate and uses it as the default for applied_exchange_rate when payableNativeCurrency differs from the payment currency. All three regression suites pass: PartnerPaidPurchaseTest (15/15), PaymentAccountingTest (13/13), PaymentOutstandingTest (12/12). Workspace has no git repository so commit was skipped. CONVERGENCE VERIFICATION (iteration 1): Full suite 163/163 pass, 441 assertions, exit code 0. No failures.
